local self=require('openmw.self')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local timer=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 timer=timer+dt;if timer<.2 then return end;timer=0
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player must remain alive')
 local a=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x032a15))
 assert(a and a:isValid() and types.Actor.isDead(a),'Original Renault corpse must persist')
 assert(#types.Actor.inventory(a):getAll()==0,'Cold corpse inventory replayed')
 print('MergeRenault cold empty corpse valid')
end}}}}
